about: Farm art Batch B (backlog #3): the game's buildings (STRUCT in index.html) and shop decorations (DECOR). Run: python3 tools/genart.py isobatch tools/batches/farmB.json (skips anything already made).

farm/bld/stand.prompt: a small wooden farmstand market stall with a red and white striped awning and crates of vegetables on the counter, wide and low

farm/bld/board.prompt: a small wooden notice board on two posts with a little peaked roof and several paper notes pinned to it, no writing

farm/bld/fbasket.prompt: a giant woven wicker basket on the ground overflowing with eggs, carrots, pumpkins and a ball of wool, with a little heart-shaped wooden sign with no writing

farm/bld/bank.prompt: a tiny cute farm bank building with cream walls, a green roof, two little columns at the door and a big gold coin emblem above the door, no writing

farm/bld/store.prompt: a big classic red barn with white trim and big open doors, a hammer and saw hanging by the door, used as the farm's building shop, no writing

farm/bld/coop.prompt: a small yellow wooden chicken coop with an orange roof, a little ramp and a round door

farm/bld/pen.prompt: a low wooden pig pen fence enclosing a muddy patch with a small wooden trough, open top

farm/bld/shed.prompt: a long low sheep shed with light grey wooden walls and a slate blue roof, wide and low

farm/bld/stable.prompt: a large brown wooden horse and cow stable with a dark roof and a big double door with a hay loft window

farm/bld/fence.prompt: one single straight row of white wooden picket fence, three posts in a line with pickets between them, standing alone on the ground, not a box, not an enclosure

farm/bld/fencecorner.prompt: one corner piece of white wooden picket farm fence forming an L shape

farm/decor/flowers.prompt: a small round patch of colorful tulips in soil

farm/decor/sunflower.prompt: a small cluster of three tall sunflowers

farm/decor/lantern.prompt: an old fashioned farm lantern on a short wooden post, warm glowing light

farm/decor/mailbox.prompt: a classic red farm mailbox on a wooden post with the little flag up, no writing

farm/decor/tree.prompt: a round leafy green apple tree with a few red apples

farm/decor/beehive.prompt: a classic white wooden beehive box on a little stand with a few cute bees

farm/decor/pond.prompt: a small round blue duck pond with reeds and a little yellow duck floating
